reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with the terrain in our game! With the new native sparse flow system, water depth is now accurately updated without freezing your gameplay, allowing for a smoother experience when shaping your environment. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Water Mechanics Enhanced in Provincia!
steam.body: We're excited to announce updates to the water mechanics in Provincia! With our new native sparse flow system, water depth is now accurately represented as you shape the landscape, ensuring a smoother and more immersive experience. For more details, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
